Component Work/comment-panel.html.title: Comment Panel
Component Work/comment-panel.html.description: Threaded comment-panel component across states: count badge, All/Open/Resolved filters, @-mention threads, and a compose footer.

Component Work/media-gen-form.html.title: Media Gen Form
Component Work/media-gen-form.html.description: States gallery for an AI media-generation modal, with a V1/V2 toggle swapping stacked modals for a dark split layout.

content-app.title: Content App
content-app.description: Dark-themed mobile learner app with a TikTok-style vertical feed of microlearning cards and Feed, Explore, Learn, and Profile nav.

Content Portal/mockups/author-create.htm.title: Author — Create
Content Portal/mockups/author-create.htm.description: Author creation form split into a public Profile and internal Vendor/Business section, with repeatable degree/publication rows.

Content Portal/mockups/author-profile.ht.title: Author Profile
Content Portal/mockups/author-profile.ht.description: Author detail page with photo header, status badge, and public-profile sections that toggle view/edit inline.

Content Portal/mockups/authors.html.title: Authors
Content Portal/mockups/authors.html.description: Authors directory with search, filters, and a sortable grid, plus a split Quick-add button opening a drawer or full form.

Content Portal/mockups/content-detail-cu.title: Content Detail — Customer
Content Portal/mockups/content-detail-cu.description: User-owned custom course detail with meta chips, three editable variants, and an editable Catalog Details form.

Content Portal/mockups/content-detail-ve.title: Content Detail — Vector
Content Portal/mockups/content-detail-ve.description: Read-only detail for a Vector-provided course with locked variants; Copy to My Library is the only edit path.

Content Portal/mockups/content-library.h.title: Content Library
Content Portal/mockups/content-library.h.description: Content Library landing: a searchable, filterable grid of courses and modules with ownership, status, and modified columns.

Content Portal/mockups/global-assets.htm.title: Global Assets
Content Portal/mockups/global-assets.htm.description: Assets manager with tabs for images, templates, themes, avatars, and voices, plus an Upload Asset action.

Content Portal/mockups.title: Overview
Content Portal/mockups.description: Lightweight Content Portal entry page that auto-redirects to the Content Library, with a manual fallback link.

Content Portal/mockups/settings.html.title: Settings
Content Portal/mockups/settings.html.description: Settings page centered on an AI Guidelines card with a 2,000-char textarea, plus coming-soon cards for lifecycle and roles.

Content Portal/mockups/variant-detail.ht.title: Variant Detail — User
Content Portal/mockups/variant-detail.ht.description: Editable user variant with audience callout, shared/unique Learning Object sections, and version history with revert.

Content Portal/mockups/variant-detail-ve.title: Variant Detail — Vector
Content Portal/mockups/variant-detail-ve.description: Read-only Vector variant with locked banner and shared sections; the sidebar offers Copy to My Library and Preview as Learner.

Exploration/scenarioManager.title: Scenario Manager
Exploration/scenarioManager.description: Branching-scenario editor with a node-graph canvas, AI branch suggestions, validation, and a play-through simulator.

Phase1/title-scene.title: Object Manager — Title Scene
Phase1/title-scene.description: Phase 1 base of the Phase 2 Object Manager: Scene Management editor with transcript cards, tab pills, empty stage, and Properties panel.

Phase1/EditLO-dialogs.title: Edit LO — Dialog States
Phase1/EditLO-dialogs.description: Reference sheet of always-open Edit Learning Object dialogs; the apply-scope radio swaps a dynamic warning notice per option.

Phase1/System-maintenance.title: System Maintenance — Banner
Phase1/System-maintenance.description: System maintenance banner states, built on the Edit LO dialog reference sheet so notice and dialog patterns stay shared.

Phase2/content-workflow/home.html.title: Content Portal Home (Overview)
Phase2/content-workflow/home.html.description: Personalized Content Portal home with an AI-builder hero, content-type tiles, recent work, and template sections.

Phase2/content-workflow.title: Content Creation Workflow
Phase2/content-workflow.description: Guided creation flow: pick a content type, then a Scenario branch (setup → Build-with-AI storyboarding chat or Start-from-scratch → objectManager-style editor with video canvas, timeline, and interaction points).

Phase2/courseOverview.html.title: Course Overview
Phase2/courseOverview.html.description: Course-authoring workspace with an icon rail and a drag-reorderable Course Structure panel beside the content view.

Phase2/legalConfirmation.html.title: Legal Confirmation
Phase2/legalConfirmation.html.description: Terms & Conditions modal requiring scroll-to-bottom before agreeing, with first-time and updated-terms variants.

Phase2/objectManager.html.title: Object Manager
Phase2/objectManager.html.description: Scene-based Learning Object editor with preview canvas, timeline, transcript, AI audio, and a scope-aware comment panel.

Phase2/step1PhoneticUpdate.html.title: Step 1 Phonetic Update
Phase2/step1PhoneticUpdate.html.description: Generate Audio modal with transcript, phonetic-text editing, and a voice picker; Add to Scene unlocks once audio is generated.

wip.html.title: WIP — Component Sandbox
wip.html.description: Scratch sandbox for component explorations, currently a custom searchable dropdown with a pinned Add-new-item action.
